algolia.name: Sony - a6000 Mirrorless Camera with 16-50mm Lens - White
algolia.description: Featuring a 16-50mm f/3.5-5.6 zoom lens, this Sony a6000 24.3-megapixel mirrorless camera lets you take up-close shots of faraway subjects in crisp, sharp detail. Fast shooting up to 11 fps helps you follow the action.  Memory card sold separately.
